name: Isklyucheniye
source:
The year is 1953. Berlin. GDR.

Two recently graduated students are appointed as camp counselors. They have 7 final days of their school life ahead of them, after which a new, adult life will begin. But what will they have to experience in this camp? 7 days of carefree fun with the kids? Or a harsh ordeal brought on by wounds that haven't healed even after many years?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2893119740]Steam[/url]]
translation:
时间是1953年，柏林。民主德国。

两名刚毕业的学生被任命为营地辅导员。他们还有学校生活的最后7天，之后新的成人生活将开始。但他们在这个营地中将会经历什么呢？与孩子一起度过7天无忧无虑的乐趣？还是多年未愈的伤口所带来的严酷折磨？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2893119740]Steam[/url]]
